description: Poll the status of a capture by token. Returns status (queued | processing | done | failed) and, when done, image_url for public (cdn) captures or a download URL for private captures (fetchable repeatedly until it auto-expires). Also returns meta_http_status, meta_final_url, and meta_page_title when available. No API key required for polling.

token.description: 32-character alphanumeric token returned by capture or batch.

name: get_status
